reviews.title: Amazing fan for the price! Excellent replacement/UPGRADE fan
reviews.comment: I got six of these fans for my to replace my old school fans and boy are they an upgrade! They MOVE air! they are a bit noisy at full speed but boy do they move some air. Excellent fan for the price. I'm seeing a 15% temperature difference in my entire system GPU included love the appearance color is amazing. installation was easy. they seem to be pretty reliable for the short time I've had them they fit perfect I love the little rubber isolators that they have in the backs of the fan
reviews.author: Joshua Jones

reviews.title: Price performance king
reviews.comment: The price to performance simply cannot be beat here. The fan is quiet, operates smoothly, and has great ARGB. It feels sturdy and does everything I expected it to do. I will note, it does bug me the logo in the center seems to be a little off center or something, however it's not enough of a problem to remove a star. Go ARCTIC, you won't regret it!
reviews.author: Matthew D

reviews.title: Best fans on the market
reviews.comment: Amazing quality, and you cant beat the price. Looks great and performs well. Plenty fast and moves a lot of air. I would recommend for anyone.
reviews.author: Robert Pysher

reviews.title: great bang for the buck. very pleased with Arctic fans.
reviews.comment: super quiet. very powerful. low power consumption allowing you to daisy chain many fans. vibrant color. piece of cake to install, mounting screws were included. they keep my system cooler than the stock fans at a lower noise level. They have separate very long cables for the pwm fans and the argb lights making your options limitless. solid construction and function perfectly.
reviews.author: Dave B

reviews.title: yep its good
reviews.comment: Blows hard, nice rgb and aesthetics, quiet (especially at low to medium rpm), low temperatures, quite good.
reviews.author: Ethan Kouts
